write_behavior: none; commands read and emit canonical JSON only

schedule_authority.admission_rule: Consume the exact harness-declared ordered schedule generically. No tension ID, expected answer, slot, route, or model exception may alter admission.

external_freeze_manifest.storage_framing: Canonical minified UTF-8 JSON in the declared key order, with exactly one terminal LF and no CR

fixed_identity_values.claim_boundary: unfinished throwaway frozen-snapshot prompt-architecture experiment only

external_freeze_manifest.runtime_dependencies_derivation: Exact path/sha256/bytes projection of architecture_contract.json runtime_dependency_closure, sorted by path, with every file independently reopened beneath successor_20260813.
external_freeze_manifest.closed_world_rule: The candidate directory must contain exactly the eleven candidate_files paths as regular nonlinks. The external manifest is outside that directory and is excluded from its own inventory.

run_contract.freeze_rule: Path must be the fixed repository-relative manifest path; SHA-256 and bytes must match current storage. The manifest and every inventory file are reopened before each command.
run_contract.sequence_two: qualification_sequence=2 and predecessor_run_id is a different valid run_id

primary_rollout_revalidation.file_rule: Exact absolute resolved path strictly beneath the session root; lstat regular nonlink, O_NOFOLLOW open, stable fstat/read, exact storage SHA-256 and bytes.
primary_rollout_revalidation.parse_rule: UTF-8 JSONL with terminal LF, no CR or blank rows, and duplicate JSON keys rejected at every object depth.
independent_derivations: one session_meta bound to thread_id and rollout filename
exactly one turn_context and one relevant delegation user message
one task_started and one task_complete bound to turn_id
exact wrapper and provider-visible harness-render bytes
openai provider and requested model/thinking in turn context and collaboration settings
full assistant final-message array and canonical hash/bytes
full prohibited-activity array and canonical hash/bytes
single text and idempotent duplicate-final normalization
status, timing, first attempt, fresh context, one session, and one turn
primary_rollout_revalidation.effective_route_limitation: Provider-effective model/thinking and a serving-snapshot attestation are not exposed; the verifier requires those receipt fields to remain null and reports the limitation.
primary_rollout_revalidation.task_identity_limitation: No separate platform task_id or direct thread/create invocation receipt is exposed. Fresh task identity is thread_id, task lifecycle identity is turn_id, and qualification requires unique values for every call.
primary_rollout_revalidation.persisted_compact_binding: Path/matrix/accounting/validation/qualification outputs carry independent rollout-validation count plus canonical aggregate SHA-256 and bytes. Secret-bearing rollout bytes are never copied into Git.

commands.validate-freeze: No subject call. Validate the fixed external manifest, passing audit, candidate closed world, exact candidate inventory, exact runtime-dependency closure, and every current regular-file hash/byte count.
commands.emit-capture: Independently reopen the primary rollout and derive the only legal v3 capture envelope.
commands.admit: Validate current freeze identity, exact next same-slot cell and deterministic prerequisites, and absence of terminal/downstream evidence before dispatch.
commands.validate-cell: Independently reopen rollout, bind receipt/capture/render, and leave PASS/FAIL authority exclusively to the harness scorer.
commands.path-terminal: Revalidate every completed rollout, derive all stopped paths, and emit only root-authorized exact terminal evidence.
commands.matrix-terminal: Revalidate all completed rollouts, persisted path terminals, accounting, and unique thread/turn identities.
commands.artifact-manifest: Revalidate the full terminal chain and emit exact closed-world run inventory.
commands.validation-report: Revalidate and bind manifest, matrix, accounting, and primary-rollout aggregate evidence.
commands.reopen-matrix-terminal: Revalidate the entire final chain from current bytes.
commands.qualify-two-runs: Require the same validated external manifest, sequence 1 then 2, two final-reopened clean matrices, 582 fresh completed PASS calls, 582 primary rollout validations, and 582 distinct thread IDs plus 582 distinct turn IDs.

terminal_rules.clean_path: 97 completed PASS calls, 97 independently reopened rollouts, unique thread and turn IDs, byte-valid S90, and no controller invalids
terminal_rules.clean_matrix: Three clean paths, 291 completed PASS calls and primary rollout validations, unique thread and turn IDs, zero invalid/missing/ineligible/retry/best-of/replacement, clean credit 1
terminal_rules.two_run_qualification: Two consecutive clean matrices bound to one validated manifest, exactly 582 PASS calls and primary rollout validations, 582 unique thread IDs and 582 unique turn IDs
terminal_rules.failure_preservation: First-attempt FAIL and controller-invalid evidence remain nonqualifying; no replacement or retry may erase them.

nonclaims: This verifier is disposable and not a production security boundary.
A valid static freeze is not an empirical subject-model pass or two-run qualification.
This contract embeds neither a passing-audit identity nor an external-manifest storage identity and does not itself authorize launch.
No separate platform task_id, direct thread/create invocation receipt, provider-effective route, or serving-snapshot attestation is claimed.
